items.title: 18.1 First Row Transition Elements (3d series) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the chapter opening and topic 18.1, printed pages 15-16.

blocks.text: Transition metals Periodic Table ke d aur f blocks mein milte hain. Yeh apni zyada density (kasafat), conductivity (bijli aur heat guzarne ki salahiyat) aur rangeen compounds banane ki wajah se pehchane jate hain. Iron (loha) insani tehzeeb ki reerh ki haddi hai; industrial revolution mein mazboot auzaar aur aaj ka steel infrastructure isi se bana. Copper, silver aur gold qadeem zamane se daulat aur izzat ki nishani hain; pehle sikkon aur zevraat mein use hote the, aur aaj corrosion (zang) se bachao aur achhi conductivity ki wajah se electronics aur dentistry (daanton ke ilaaj) mein zaroori hain. Gaari ke steel se le kar smartphone ke gold tak, transition metals hamari zindagi ke liye bohat qeemti hain. Electronic configuration ke lihaz se inhein do blocks mein baanta jata hai: d-block (bahar wale electrons d-orbitals mein bhar rahe hon) aur f-block (bahar wale electrons f-orbitals mein bhar rahe hon). d-block elements rozmarra zindagi mein zyada aam hain, aur in mein pehli row (3d-series) sab se ahem hai, is liye is chapter mein hum 3d transition elements hi parhenge.

Pehli row ke transition elements Periodic Table ke d block ke woh elements hain jin ki kisi bhi stable oxidation state mein d-orbitals adhoore (partially filled) bhare hon. Kitab kehti hai ke inhein transition elements is liye kehte hain ke yeh badalti (variable) oxidation states ke darmiyan transition (tabdeeli) dikhate hain. d-block groups 3 se 12 tak hai, lekin zinc aur scandium ko transition elements nahi gina jata. Zn sirf ek ion (Zn²⁺) banata hai jis ka 3d subshell poora bhara hai: Zn²⁺ = [Ar] 3d¹⁰ 4s⁰.

blocks.title: Transition element
blocks.text: Woh d-block element jis ka kam az kam ek stable ion aisa ho jis ka d subshell adhoora (partially filled) ho.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Zinc ka wahid ion Zn²⁺ hai jis ka 3d subshell poora (3d¹⁰) hai. Scandium sirf Sc³⁺ banata hai jis ka 3d subshell bilkul khaali (3d⁰) hai (Quick Check 18.1 dekhein). Dono ka koi stable ion adhoora d subshell nahi rakhta, is liye pehli row ke transition elements titanium se copper tak hain.

blocks.prompt: Zinc d-block element hai lekin transition element kyun nahi?
blocks.explanation: Is ka wahid ion Zn²⁺ hai jis ka 3d subshell poora bhara hai ([Ar] 3d¹⁰), is liye is ka koi stable ion adhoore d subshell wala nahi.

items: Transition element: d-block element jis ke stable ion ka d subshell adhoora ho.
Pehli row (3d series): Ti se Cu; Sc (Sc³⁺, 3d⁰) aur Zn (Zn²⁺, 3d¹⁰) shamil nahi.
